info.fixture: Synthetic fixtures on the real local development server. Each screenshot identifies its own source and describes the actual workflow state. Capture email uses the loopback TLS sink. No production participant data or credentials are included.
info.captureMethod: Manual rendered-UI captures through documented Codex CUA APIs, using the in-app browser and a task-scoped Microsoft Edge fallback. Saved full-frame step JPEGs receive pixel review before acceptance; original and crop provenance remain per image.
